content:
Aisha Khan: Hey everyone, on my first day and bumping into a weird identity mix. I signed up with the Okta link but Okta shows my account as two entries: a_primary aisha@redwood.com and a_secondary aisha.khan@appleid.com. I also can't see the engineering shared vault in 1Password (only the personal vault). When I try to enroll a passkey from Safari I get an error 'Unable to create credential: NotAllowedError'. Any ideas?
Tom (People Ops): Welcome Aisha! :wave: Sorry for the rough start. Please DM me the appleid address and I'll remove it from your profile. Quick Q: did you previously accept any invites using your personal Apple ID on the welcome page?
Aisha Khan: I clicked a link earlier from my phone while trying to complete onboarding and it might have used my personal Apple Keychain to accept the 1Password link. Also my laptop is corporate-managed MacBook Air (M1) with Redwood MDM.
IT Support: Thanks Aisha. Two things to check: 1) If you accepted an invite via your phone and used iCloud Keychain, it can tie a passkey/appleid credential to your personal AppleID. 2) The NotAllowedError usually means the browser blocked the credential creation - often an iframe/security or MDM policy issue. Which browser and OS version?
Aisha Khan: macOS 13.4, Safari 16.4. I tried Chrome too and saw 'Authenticator not available' briefly.
Maria (IT): MDM can enforce some security settings that disable platform authenticators for sites not on the allowlist. We'll check the device profile. Also we'll remove the secondary identity from Okta so the Okta provisioner doesn't send invites to the appleid address. Tom, can you confirm People Ops removed the alt contact?
Tom (People Ops): Removing now. Also re-sent 1Password invite to aisha@redwood.com and removed the appleid address from the HR record. You should get an email shortly.
onboarding-bot: [ONB-9123] Invite resent to aisha@redwood.com by Tom (People Ops).
Aisha Khan: Got the 1Password invite to workmail now, but still no engineering vault access -- only my personal vault shows up.
DevEx - Priya: Vault access usually maps to GSuite group membership -> provisioning -> 1Password group sync. If Okta/GSuite group mapping didn't hit your account yet you won't see the team vault. I can run a provisioning resync if Maria confirms the Okta identity cleanup is complete.
Maria (IT): Cleanup done at 1923456890. Kicked a resync for groups at 1923456910: command `provisioner sync --user aisha.khan`. Should be quick.
onboarding-bot: [ONB-9123] Provisioning resync requested by Maria (IT).
Aisha Khan: After 1923456950 I still couldn't create a passkey in Safari. Error now says "Operation aborted by user" even though I clicked continue.
IT Support: Two additional checks: 1) In System Settings -> Passwords, check if 'Allow websites to use passkeys' is enabled. 2) For MDM: some older MDM profiles block passkeys for third-party sites; we can push a profile update. I'm marking a ticket IT-6719 and assigning to Maria.
Maria (IT): Pushed MDM profile update at 1923457000 that allows the platform authenticator for approved onboarding flows. Also reattempted YubiKey registration flow: try Chrome + USB-C slot, and for Safari use the native System Settings path (Password > Add Passkey).
Aisha Khan: Tried adding passkey in System Settings at 1923457015 and it worked! Also the engineering vault appeared in 1Password at 1923457025. Everything seems good now.
Tom (People Ops): Welcome aboard again :tada: — closing ONB-9123. Reach out if anything else.
IT Support: Marking IT-6719 resolved. Reopen if you hit further MDM or passkey issues. :white_check_mark:
